annotations.title: Suggest an edit to someone's story

description: Propose a revision of a worklore story written by SOMEONE ELSE, for its author to accept or decline — worklore's pull request. Use it when, while reproducing a story, a step turned out wrong, outdated or missing (a library changed, the docs caught up, a command no longer exists). Call get_story first, make the change in the COMPLETE markdown (frontmatter + '# title' + narrative + '## Reproduce this'; keep the frontmatter `date` exactly as it is), show the human a before/after diff and the rationale, and send it only with their EXPLICIT approval. The story does NOT change: the author is notified, reviews the diff, and either accepts it as a revision (the signed-in account is credited on the story) or declines it, in which case they may hand the text back as a draft of the signed-in account's own, adapted from theirs. One open suggestion per person per story; sending another replaces it. For the user's OWN story use edit_story instead.

markdown.description: The complete story markdown as you propose it, frontmatter included, with the original `date` unchanged.

rationale.description: One or two lines (max 500 chars): what was wrong or outdated, and what you changed. The author reads this first.

slug.description: The slug of the story (by another author) to propose a revision of.

name: suggest_edit
